description: Synthetic static-contract walkthroughs, not executable decisions, model evaluation or live-provider qualification.

cases.given: The coordinator responds, discovery is absent, its queue is stale and activation is held. A manual review succeeded previously.
cases.expected: Keep current discovery health unknown, not authenticated-empty or an auth outage. Escalate the concrete held dependency once; continue only supported authorized independent manual work.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: A prior successful manual review proves historical capability, not current liveness.
An absent process alone is not an authentication outage.
condition, evidence, impact, next owner, resumption condition and default path.
An unanswered approval form is not approval
manual review can continue for unattempted eligible retained candidates

cases.given: A malformed local argument is rejected before invocation. A corrected argument is available within the existing mandate.
cases.expected: Make one bounded corrected attempt without a new permission ceremony; preserve the original clocks and budget. If invocation is uncertain, reconcile instead.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: correct the caller input within existing authority and make one bounded corrected attempt.
If invocation may have occurred, preserve the unknown effect and reconcile it first
references/throughput-and-loops.md: A bounded local assembly correction is not permission to reset the original attempt window.

cases.given: A read operation exits zero but embeds an access error. An unrelated operation family still works.
cases.expected: Stop the affected operation, not the whole role. Keep source membership unknown and do not retry unchanged on a timer. Any changed-input attempt stays bounded.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: including provider errors embedded in an exit-zero response.
Do not retry unchanged on a timer or blanket-block unrelated working operation families.
Preserve the original failure, clocks, attempt budget and unknown effects

cases.given: One enumeration returns no captured body; another successfully returns complete scoped pagination with no candidates or provider error.
cases.expected: The first source is unknown. Only the second establishes a healthy empty population, which still does not complete a continuous role.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: claim an empty population only after a successful, complete scoped enumeration with no provider error.
Empty/unknown capture, partial pages or a success footer alone never establish an empty source.
references/throughput-and-loops.md: A zero actionable queue in continuous mode means idle and observing, not complete.

cases.given: A reviewer closes its own thread after a bounded delta assessment. The receipt is accepted but clearing the pending marker fails, then the receipt is delivered again.
cases.expected: Retain the actual delta/finding coverage and uncertainty, not full-review credit. Reconcile the accepted revision and pending marker without double counting or reposting.

references/coordination-and-recovery.md: A bounded delta or closure of the reviewer's own thread does not earn credit for a fresh full review
Receipt integration and its pending-result marker must refer to the same accepted state revision
A repeated delivery must not count twice.

cases.given: A result awaits acceptance, an eligible vacancy exists, retained source is still applicable and only a final status snapshot is timed.
cases.expected: Accept and refill before optional dashboard work, reuse valid evidence and keep unmeasured intervals unknown. Do not reset original clocks or infer the slow phase from the snapshot.

references/throughput-and-loops.md: Prioritize returned-result acceptance and eligible lane refill before optional dashboard work.
Reuse applicable retained source and findings
A status snapshot or elapsed wall time alone cannot identify the bottleneck

cases.given: The role is stopped with one owned watch, another role's schedule, an uncertain post, useful WIP and an open author-owned PR.
cases.expected: Stop only owned flows, reconcile the uncertain effect and transfer remaining work through a tracked objective or accepted custodian. Keep records and PR custody; report unsettled obligations.

references/coordination-and-recovery.md: stop only this role's owned watches, schedules and nudges
merely naming a proposed recipient is not accepted custody.
Closing the role does not delete records/resources, abandon an open PR
not a promise of runtime-enforced cleanup.
